summary: Review flashcards anywhere, even without Wi-Fi.
page_description: Study with large reveal and answer controls designed for a Kobo screen.
release_notes: Preview a card's front, back and media on your computer before importing, and see how many cards and how much media a package holds. Merging and replacing a collection are now separate, named choices.
user: Somebody keeping a memory practice going on their Kobo.
job: Review the cards that are due, wherever the reader is.
offline: The collection and your reviews live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: the card collection you staged from your computer
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not needed; the originals stay on your computer

data.kind: your review log, which drives what is due next
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered from the app; the log stays on the reader and drives what is due next

non_goals: It does not build collections; your computer does that.
It does not sync reviews on its own.
